text:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — promo blast last night drove a signup surge. HubSpot enrichment lagged and round-robin stalled; we observed ~1h unowned leads during business hours (SLA = 25m). Can we put a short hotpatch live to protect the funnel? cc @Sam @Diego
Sam L: Confirmed. Enrich workers are stuck on a 3rd-party DNS lookup; websocket retries pile up and the router waits for enrichment before assigning.
Diego V: Proposal: an assign_grace_timer for tag:promo that marks leads as 'candidate' after Xs of pending-enrich, then runs a lightweight assigner to a standby pool (standby-sdr) with a low-confidence header. Later, if enrichment returns, we allow a single swap to the enriched owner. Limits: swaps <= 1 per lead.
Olivia P: Good call. Add scope rules: only for sources [twitter, ads], only for campaign = promo-2024, and exclude enterprise accounts (company_size > 1000). Also require feature-flag gating.
Maya R: Safety first — we must avoid duplicate claims and churn. Metrics to add: candidate_count, initial_assign_time, swap_count, duplicate_assigns. Alert if duplicate_assigns > 2 in 1h.
Sam L: Pseudocode I sketched:
```
if (lead.tag == 'promo' && lead.source in ['twitter','ads'] && !enterprise && now - enrich.created_at > 100000 && !lead.flags.grace_assigned) {
  lead.flags.grace_assigned = true
  enqueueAssign(lead, 'standby-sdr', metadata={confidence:'low', fallback:true})
}
// on enrich callback
if (enrich.arrived && lead.current_owner != enrich.recommended_owner && lead.swap_count < 1) {
  replaceOwner(lead, enrich.recommended_owner)
  lead.swap_count += 1
}
```
Diego V: I'll open the PR and flip ff.assign_grace_timer.promo=true for canary. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> monitor 1h -> 100% if stable. Will include rollback steps.
Olivia P: I'll draft a short note to Sales: owners marked with header X are low-confidence; do not action until enrichment arrives. Also add a small FAQ so CS knows what to expect.
Sam L: I'll add dashboard panels and alerts: time_to_first_claim_by_campaign, candidate_count, swap_rate, duplicate_assigns. I'll also prepare a replay test: `python tools/replay_leads.py --file promo_sample.csv --delay 120`.

Diego V: PR: https://git.redwood/routing/pull/1012 - changes: assign_grace_timer (100s), standby-sdr target, swap cap=1. JIRA: https://jira.redwood/browse/MKT-7000
Maya R: Nice work. Post-deploy checks: 1) no duplicate owners seen, 2) candidate_count metric increments, 3) time_to_first_claim back under 25m. If swap_rate > 10% after 24h, we open a follow-up for permanent fixes. Thanks team :rocket:
